tha-ap372:1.1: Salaḷapupphiya.] Candabhāgānadītīre ahosiṃ kinnaro tadā / ath' addasaṃ devadevaṃ caṅkamantaṃ narāsabhaṃ. // //
tha-ap372:2.1: Ocinitvāna salaḷaṃ pupphaṃ Buddhass' adās' ahaṃ / upasiṅghi mahāvīro salaḷaṃ devagandhikaṃ. // //
tha-ap372:3.1: Paṭiggahetvā sambuddho Vipassī lokanāyako / upasiṅghi mahāvīro pekkhamānassa me sadā. // //
tha-ap372:4.1: Pasannacitto sumano vanditvā dipaduttamaṃ / añjalim paggahetvāna puna pabbatam āruhiṃ. // //
tha-ap372:5.1: Ekanavute ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhipūjayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap372:7.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasā Salaḷapupphiyo thero i. g. a-ti.
tha-ap372:11.1: Mandāravañ ca Kekkhāru Bhisa-Kesarapupphiyo Aṅkolako Kadambī ca Uddālī Ekacampako Timiraṃ Salaḷañ c' eva gāthā tālīsam eva ca.
